summary: Kroger filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on September 29, 2026, for a $1.5 billion two-tranche senior notes offering: $650 million of 5.800% senior notes due February 15, 2032, and $850 million of 6.200% senior notes due November 1, 2036. Notes priced at 99.967 and 99.756, with underwriting discounts of 0.600% and 0.650%, yielding net proceeds of roughly $1.488 billion before expenses. Notes accrue from October 5, 2026, settle same date via DTC book-entry, carry make-whole redemption rights and a change-of-control repurchase obligation. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch leverage near $17.0 billion and refinancing spreads.
